definitions: To form (fabric or a fabric article) by interlacing long threads passing in one direction with others at a right angle to them.
To make (a complex story or pattern) from a number of individual items or details.
To make one's way by moving in and out among a series of objects or people.
examples: She began to weave the yarn into a scarf.
He can weave a compelling narrative.
The car had to weave through heavy traffic.
